title: Introducing "Ophidian Whisper"
author: Fun_Worry_3079
selftext:
Today, I am announcing my latest project, "Ophidian Whisper." The game is based on a fifth-edition adventure I began writing over two years ago, so seeing it coming to fruition in the form of a video game is a dream come true. The included video is a sort of "music video" for the main title theme of the game, which was created in Suno Music. It would be my honor if you'd take the time to give it a listen and let me know your thoughts/comments.

  
The game currently has a release window between September and December 2026.

comments.author: ThickBootyEnjoyer
comments.body: I'm all for ai coding help, but I'm not ok with ai music. That you're stealing somebody's voice...

replies.author: Fun_Worry_3079
replies.body: The song is only for promotional purposes. I don’t mind AI music - instrumental, that is - but I rarely generate music with vocals. I agree that it’s stealing someone’s voice and, while I love what AI can produce, I don’t like unethical uses for it.

replies.author: ThickBootyEnjoyer
replies.body: Yeah agreed, instrumentals idgaf about, but when a voice is used, yes it's generated, but it's identical to some people's voices and that's not cool.

replies.author: rmfrost
replies.body:
There are "AI training" companies, like Aligner, that hire people specifically to train other company's AI off of their voice.

So, no, AI isn't "stealing" anyone's voice (if they're "training" ethically, anyway). It's being trained on people that are allowing their voice to be used for that purpose.

replies.author: Fun_Worry_3079
replies.body: I know what you mean, and I wasn’t using the phrase to insult Suno or anyone else.

comments.author: rmfrost
comments.body: Unless you're spending an enormous amount of money churning through tokens for AI to build pretty much everything for you (sorry that Fable 5 isn't available from Claude anymore), September 2026 is EXTREMELY ambitious, even for a game built almost entirely out of AI.

replies.author: Fun_Worry_3079
replies.body: I spend about $70/month, between Suno, Copilot, and PixelLab, so not all of the work will be centralized to just one AI program. Also, I’m just now working on the simple parts of the program (mechanics tuning, etc.), so it’s not really hitting the AI that hard. Now, it will once I start importing sprite sheets, music, etc; that work is a way’s off.

comments.body:
this sounds awesome! Does it play in browser?

Can we include your game on our game portal website SLAGDOCK? Similar to miniclip, kongregate, newgrounds. They will be able to access the website and play your game right there.

replies.author: Fun_Worry_3079
replies.body: The game is currently slated for release some time between September 2026 and the end of the year. At that time, if you’re still interested, we can talk about the game’s inclusion on your website.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: sounds good! Site will still be in development until then and hopefully live by then? haha
